record.field: for production in records: try: # STEP 1 - CONFIRM if production.state == 'draft': production.action_confirm() # STEP 2 - ASSIGN (reserve components) production.action_assign() # STEP 3 - SET qty_producing production.write({'qty_producing': production.product_qty}) # STEP 4 - set_qty_producing() setea qty_done en todos los componentes production.set_qty_producing() # STEP 5 - MARK DONE sin wizards # En Odoo 17 button_mark_done() puede levantar: # - mrp.immediate.transfer → si hay componentes sin qty_done # - mrp.production.backorder → si qty_producing < product_qty # La solución es llamar _pre_button_mark_done() + con el contexto correcto production.with_context( skip_immediate=True, skip_backorder=True, mo_ids_to_backorder=None ).button_mark_done() except Exception as e: production.message_post( body="❌ ERROR DETECTED: " + str(e) ) raise

today = datetime.date.today() records = env['x_control_de_desecho'].search([ ('x_studio_active', '=', True), ('x_studio_next_date', '>=', datetime.datetime.combine(today, datetime.time.min)), ('x_studio_next_date', '<=', datetime.datetime.combine(today, datetime.time.max)), ]) for record in records: product = record.x_studio_product_product locations = record.x_studio_warehouse if not product: continue if not locations: continue # Cachear como string ANTES del bucle: si un scrap falla y la caché # del producto se invalida, el message_post al final seguirá funcionando. product_name = product.display_name errors = [] # acumular errores para postear UN solo mensaje al final # 🔹 Agrupar stock por ubicación en UNA sola query quant_data = env['stock.quant'].read_group( [ ('product_id', '=', product.id), ('location_id', 'in', locations.ids), ('quantity', '>', 0) ], ['quantity:sum'], ['location_id'] ) for quant in quant_data: location_id = quant['location_id'][0] total_qty = quant['quantity'] if total_qty <= 0: continue # SAVEPOINT manual con SQL (en safe_eval `with` está prohibido). # Nombre único por record + location para evitar colisiones. sp_name = "sp_scrap_%s_%s" % (record.id, location_id) env.cr.execute("SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) try: scrap = env['stock.scrap'].create({ 'product_id': product.id, 'scrap_qty': total_qty, 'location_id': location_id, 'company_id': record.x_studio_company.id, 'origin': record.display_name, }) scrap.action_validate() # Éxito: liberamos el savepoint env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) except Exception as e: # Fallo: rollback al savepoint deja la transacción exterior sana env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) errors.append((location_id, str(e))) # 🔹 Actualizar fechas en un solo write now = datetime.datetime.utcnow() vals = { 'x_studio_last_date': now } if record.x_studio_frequency: frequency = int(record.x_studio_frequency) next_date = now + datetime.timedelta(days=frequency) if record.x_studio_weekday: target_weekday = int(record.x_studio_weekday) - 1 days_to_add = (target_weekday - next_date.weekday()) % 7 next_date = next_date + datetime.timedelta(days=days_to_add) vals['x_studio_next_date'] = next_date record.write(vals) # UN solo mensaje al chatter, solo si hubo errores if errors: lines = "".join( f"
  • Ubicación #{loc_id}: {msg}
    • " for loc_id, msg in errors ) record.message_post( body=f"🚨 ERROR procesando desecho automático {product_name}:
      {lines}
    " )

# ============================================================================ # GoodNews · Auto-validar desechos de store-operations # Tipo: Regla de automatizacion (base.automation) # Modelo: stock.scrap # Disparador: Al crear # Dominio: [('origin', 'ilike', 'store-operations-')] # Accion: Ejecutar codigo Python # safe_eval: sin import / def / with / lambda / comprehensions / fields.* # # Flujo: validar -> si falta stock, regularizar quant al entero superior # -> volver a validar. # ============================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- BLOQUE 0 # Constantes (unico sitio a tocar) EXECUTE = True # False = simulacion (todo se revierte, solo chatter) ADJUST_STOCK = True # False = comportamiento antiguo (no regulariza) MAX_AUTO_ADJUST_QTY = 10.0 # tope de seguridad; 0.0 = sin limite ERROR_MSG_MAX_CHARS = 300 STATE_DONE = "done" STATE_CANCEL = "cancel" TYPE_STORABLE = "product" NOTE_SUBTYPE = "mail.mt_note"
precision = env["decimal.precision"].precision_get("Product Unit of Measure")
for record in records: if record.state == STATE_DONE or record.state == STATE_CANCEL: continue
sp_name = "sp_auto_scrap_%s" % int(record.id) env.cr.execute("SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) try: note = ""
# -------------------------------------------------------- PASO 1 # Primer intento. Si falta stock, Odoo devuelve el dict del asistente # stock.warn.insufficient.qty.scrap SIN escribir nada. result = record.action_validate()
# -------------------------------------------------------- PASO 2 # Regularizacion: crear/ajustar quant al entero superior de la merma. needs_adjust = isinstance(result, dict) if needs_adjust and ADJUST_STOCK and record.product_id.type == TYPE_STORABLE: product = record.product_id company = record.company_id or env.company quantEnv = env["stock.quant"].sudo().with_company(company.id).with_context(inventory_mode=True)
# Mismos criterios que usa action_validate() para medir disponible. quants = quantEnv._gather(product, record.location_id, lot_id=record.lot_id, package_id=record.package_id, owner_id=record.owner_id, strict=True) available = sum(quants.mapped("quantity"))
# scrap_qty puede venir en otra UdM: convertir a la UdM del producto. qty_needed = record.product_uom_id._compute_quantity(record.scrap_qty, product.uom_id)
# Entero superior: 0,25 -> 1 ; 1,5 -> 2 ; 2,0 -> 2 target = int(qty_needed) if float_compare(qty_needed, target, precision_digits=precision) > 0: target = target + 1
over_limit = False if MAX_AUTO_ADJUST_QTY > 0.0: if float_compare(target, MAX_AUTO_ADJUST_QTY, precision_digits=precision) > 0: over_limit = True
if over_limit: note = ("Ajuste automatico NO aplicado: la cantidad requerida (%s) supera " "el tope de seguridad (%s)." % (target, MAX_AUTO_ADJUST_QTY)) else: # inventory_quantity_auto_apply fija el TOTAL del quant, no suma. # Si ya habia algo suelto, se ajusta ese quant para que el total # disponible alcance el entero objetivo. base_qty = 0.0 if quants: base_qty = quants[0].quantity new_qty = base_qty + (target - available)
vals = { "product_id": product.id, "location_id": record.location_id.id, "inventory_quantity_auto_apply": new_qty, } if record.lot_id: vals["lot_id"] = record.lot_id.id if record.package_id: vals["package_id"] = record.package_id.id if record.owner_id: vals["owner_id"] = record.owner_id.id
quantEnv.create(vals)
note = ("Regularizacion automatica de stock previa al desecho.\n" "Producto: %s\n" "Ubicacion: %s\n" "Lote: %s\n" "Disponible: %s %s\n" "Necesario: %s %s\n" "Ajustado a: %s %s" % (product.display_name, record.location_id.display_name, record.lot_id.name or "-", available, product.uom_id.name, qty_needed, product.uom_id.name, target, product.uom_id.name))
# ------------------------------------------------ PASO 3 # Segundo intento, ya con stock suficiente. result = record.action_validate()
env.flush_all()
# -------------------------------------------------------- PASO 4 if not EXECUTE: env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) env.invalidate_all(flush=False) body = "SIMULACION (EXECUTE=False). No se ha modificado nada." if note: body = body + "\n" + note if isinstance(result, dict): body = body + "\nResultado: el desecho NO se habria validado." else: body = body + "\nResultado: el desecho se habria validado." record.message_post(body=body, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE)
elif isinstance(result, dict): # Sigue sin poder validarse tras el ajuste (o ADJUST_STOCK=False). env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) env.invalidate_all(flush=False) body = "Desecho automatico no validado: stock insuficiente." if note: body = body + "\n" + note record.message_post(body=body, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE)
else: env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) if note: record.message_post(body=note, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE)
except Exception as e: env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) env.invalidate_all(flush=False) record.message_post( body="Error validando desecho automatico: %s" % str(e)[:ERROR_MSG_MAX_CHARS], subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE, )
